bio: Experience a quintessentially English Afternoon Tea at The Gore London. Located in the heart of Kensington, this unique venue has provided their guests with elegance and charm for over a century.  The Afternoon Tea combines the authentic tradition with contemporary British cuisine to give the ultimate Afternoon Tea experience.  Their menu comprises of a selection of finger sandwiches and savoury treats alongside genuine scones and seasonal cakes. Guests can also choose to upgrade to an English sparkling Afternoon Tea or an English sparkling Rosé Afternoon Tea.  The Gore is located in Kensington, just a stone's throw away from The Royal Albert Hall and Hyde Park. It is a short distance from Gloucester Road or High Street Kensington station.
